recipes.title: Whipped Feta Dip
steps: Blend the feta and yogurt until very smooth.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with honey and oil and scatter with lemon zest and chili.

recipes.title: Muhammara
steps: Blend everything to a thick, slightly coarse paste.
Season and serve with pita and vegetables.

recipes.title: Queso Dip
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened.
Add the cheese a handful at a time, stirring until smooth.
Stir in the jalapeno, salsa and cumin and serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Mix the cream cheese, hot sauce and ranch until smooth, then the chicken and half the cheese.
Spread in a small dish, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.
Serve with celery and chips.

recipes.title: Spinach Yogurt Dip
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil, then cool, squeeze dry and chop.
Stir into the yogurt with the garlic, mint and salt.
Chill and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Black Bean Dip
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Serve with tortilla chips or vegetables.

recipes.title: French Onion Yogurt Dip
steps: Cook the onions slowly in the butter for 20 minutes until deep golden, then cool.
Stir into the yogurt and sour cream with the Worcestershire and salt.
Chill 1 hour and serve with chips.

recipes.title: Tomato and Ricotta Crostini
steps: Brush the bread with oil and toast at 200°C (400°F) for 5 minutes.
Spread with ricotta, top with tomatoes and basil.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Mushroom Crostini with Thyme
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter with the garlic and thyme for 8 minutes until browned.
Spread the toasts with goat cheese and pile the mushrooms on top.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Bites
steps: Mix the cream cheese with the dill and a squeeze of lemon.
Spread on the cucumber slices.
Top with a fold of smoked salmon and a little more dill.

recipes.title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Melon
steps: Wrap each melon wedge with a slice of prosciutto.
Sprinkle with pepper and tuck in a mint leaf.

recipes.title: Bacon-Wrapped Dates
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Stuff the dates with goat cheese if using, wrap each in half a bacon slice and secure with a toothpick.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Party Meatballs
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, onion and salt and roll into 30 small balls.
Bake on a lined tray 15 minutes.
Warm the chili sauce and jelly in a pan until smooth, add the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Mini Caprese Tartlets
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the pastry into 12 squares and press into a muffin tin.
Add a little pesto, mozzarella and tomato to each.
Bake 12 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Cheese and Herb Gougeres
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Bring the water, milk, butter and salt to a boil, tip in the flour and beat over the heat 1 minute until it forms a ball.
Cool 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese and chives.
Pipe or spoon small mounds on a lined tray and bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Skewers
steps: Toss the shrimp with the oil, Cajun seasoning and garlic and thread onto skewers.
Grill or griddle 2 to 3 minutes a side until pink.
Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay Skewers
steps: Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce, curry powder, turmeric, sugar and oil for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or broil 4 to 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked.
Serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Antipasto Skewers
steps: Thread the tortellini, salami, mozzarella, olives and tomatoes onto small skewers.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.

recipes.title: Halloumi Fries
steps: Toss the halloumi in the flour and paprika.
Fry in the oil 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden (or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 8 minutes).
Drizzle with honey and scatter with pomegranate.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pakoras
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, spices and salt with the water to a thick batter.
Stir in the vegetables.
Fry spoonfuls in 2 cm hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until crisp; drain.
Serve with chutney or raita.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, paprika and salt, then the egg and milk to a thick batter.
Fold in the corn and green onions.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with sour cream or sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Zucchini Feta Fritters
steps: Mix the zucchini, feta, green onions, dill, egg, flour and pepper.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with tzatziki or yogurt.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the sausage meat with the onion and sage.
Cut the pastry in half lengthways, lay a log of sausage along each, roll up and seal.
Cut into short lengths, brush with egg and bake 22 to 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Mini Chicken Sliders
steps: Mix the chicken, breadcrumbs, garlic powder, paprika and salt and shape 12 small patties.
Fry 4 to 5 minutes a side until cooked, adding the cheese for the last minute.
Assemble in the buns with mayonnaise and lettuce.

recipes.title: Crispy Potato Skins
steps: Bake the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 1 hour, then halve and scoop out most of the flesh (save it for mash).
Brush the skins with oil and bake 10 minutes until crisp.
Fill with cheese and bacon and bake 5 minutes more.
Top with sour cream and green onions.

recipes.title: Spring Onion Pancakes
steps: Mix the flour and hot water into a dough, knead 5 minutes and rest 20 minutes.
Divide into 4, roll each thin, brush with sesame oil, sprinkle with salt and green onions, roll up into a rope, coil and roll flat again.
Fry in the vegetable oil 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with soy sauce mixed with vinegar.

recipes.title: Vegetable Summer Rolls
steps: Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water for a few seconds until just soft.
Lay on a damp board, add a little of each filling and roll up tightly, folding in the sides.
Repeat and serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Energy Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Coconut Date Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Lemon Cashew Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Energy Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Almond Apricot Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Brownie Bites (No-Bake)
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Rosemary Roasted Almonds
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Honey Cinnamon Roasted Walnuts
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (335°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Spicy Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Ranch Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (390°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted and crunchy.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Curry Roasted Cashews
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Smoky Paprika Mixed Nuts
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 14 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Kale Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (300°F).
Massage the oil into the dry kale and spread on two trays without overlapping.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until crisp but still green.
Sprinkle with salt and nutritional yeast.

recipes.title: Homemade Pita Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Toss the pita with the oil, za'atar and salt.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

recipes.title: Baked Tortilla Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Toss the wedges with the oil and lime zest and spread on trays.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until crisp and lightly golden.
Sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Parmesan Crisps
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Drop tablespoons of parmesan onto a lined tray, flatten slightly and sprinkle with pepper and thyme.
Bake 5 to 6 minutes until golden and lacy.
Cool on the tray until crisp.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Popcorn
steps: Heat the oil with 3 kernels in a large lidded pan; when they pop add the rest and cover.
Shake the pan while it pops, then take off the heat when popping slows.
Toss with the butter, sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Spicy Lime Popcorn
steps: Pop the kernels in the oil in a covered pan, shaking often.
Toss with the lime zest, chili powder and salt while hot.

recipes.title: Trail Mix
steps: Mix everything together.
Store in an airtight jar and portion into small bags for hikes and lunch boxes.

recipes.title: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter Dip
steps: Stir the peanut butter, yogurt, honey and cinnamon until smooth.
Serve with the apple slices (toss them in a little lemon juice if not eating straight away).

recipes.title: Cucumber Sushi Bites

ingredients.name: Cooked rice, seasoned with 1 tbsp rice vinegar

steps: Scoop a little out of the top of each cucumber slice.
Top with a small mound of rice, then salmon and avocado.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Hard-Boiled Egg Snack Plates
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 to 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Halve and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Arrange on plates with the vegetables, cheese and crackers.

recipes.title: Ants on a Log
steps: Fill the celery pieces with peanut butter.
Dot with raisins. A good one for kids to make themselves.

recipes.title: Roasted Seaweed Rice Crackers
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix the rice, nori, sesame oil, seeds and salt.
Press very thinly between two sheets of parchment and peel off the top sheet.
Bake 15 minutes until crisp, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the onion softens. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken thighs and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and discard the bay leaf.
Select Sauté, bring the soup to a boil, add the noodles and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Split Pea Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rinsed split peas, bay leaf and ham hock if using; do not fill the pot above the half line because split peas foam.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Remove the bay leaf and the ham hock (pull the meat off the bone and return it).
Stir well; the peas break down as they cool. Thin with water if needed and season to taste.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lentil Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils and tomatoes but do not stir the tomatoes in; leaving them on top helps prevent a burn warning.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Add a squeeze of lemon and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Minestrone
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the zucchini, beans and pasta, then pour the tomatoes over the top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for a minute.
Season and serve topped with parmesan if you like.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Black Bean Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked black beans and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 35 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Discard the bay leaf. Blend about a third of the soup with a stick blender to thicken it.
Season with salt and lime juice, and serve with cilantro and sour cream.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Potato Leek Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the leeks for 5 to 6 minutes until soft but not brown. Stir in the garlic and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender.
Stir in the cream, season, and top with chives.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the sugar and half the basil, then pour the tomatoes on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Add the rest of the basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil and cook the onion and apple for 4 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the squash, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk, season, and top with toasted pumpkin seeds.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and jalapeno for 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin and chili powder.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken, beans and corn, then pour the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken in the pot with two forks.
Season with lime juice and salt, and top each bowl with avocado, crushed tortilla chips and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef and Barley Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the beef in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch. Add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the barley and mushrooms.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season with salt and pepper; the barley keeps thickening the soup as it stands.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the wild rice and chicken.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken.
Whisk the cornstarch into the cream, stir it in and simmer on Sauté for 2 to 3 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Red Lentil Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth.
Season, and serve with lemon wedges and a pinch of dried mint.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ham and Bean Soup

ingredients.name: Dried navy beans, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked beans, ham and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Discard the bay leaf, mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken, and season to taste.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Zuppa Toscana
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the sausage, breaking it up, for about 5 minutes. Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes, then the garlic and pepper flakes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Select Sauté, stir in the kale and cream and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until the kale is tender. Season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 2 minutes, then stir in the curry paste and ginger for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken and mushrooms.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Select Sauté, stir in the coconut milk and fish sauce and bring just to a simmer.
Add lime juice to taste and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot French Onion Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter, add the onions and sugar and cook, stirring often, for 10 to 12 minutes until softened and starting to colour. Stir in the garlic. Add the wine and let it bubble for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the thyme and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Select Sauté and simmer for 5 minutes with the lid off to deepen the flavour, then season.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with toasted baguette and gruyere and grill until bubbling.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegetable Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then the garlic and Italian seasoning.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes and green beans, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the frozen peas and leave for 2 minutes to heat through.
Season to taste.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Pozole Verde
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes, then the garlic, cumin and oregano for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken, hominy and salsa verde.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken, season with salt and lime, and serve with sliced radish and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the ginger for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the carrots.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth, stir in the coconut milk and a squeeze of orange juice, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mushroom Barley Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the mushrooms until they release their liquid, about 5 minutes. Add the onion, carrot and celery and cook 3 minutes more.

Pour in the stock and soy sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the barley, thyme and the porcini if using.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 20 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season and stir in the dill.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Corn Chowder
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Cook the bacon until crisp, about 5 minutes, and lift out half for garnish. Add the onion and celery and cook for 2 minutes, then the garlic and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes and corn.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Whisk the cornstarch into the milk, stir it in and simmer on Sauté until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Mash some potatoes into the soup, season, and top with the reserved bacon and chives.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Moroccan Chickpea Soup

ingredients.name: Dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic and the spices for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked chickpeas and lentils, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Season with salt and lemon juice and stir in the cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Egg Drop Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the white parts of the green onions and the ginger for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and soy sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the corn.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 2 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Select Sauté and bring to a boil. Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water and cook 1 minute.
Turn off the pot, stir in one direction and slowly pour in the eggs so they form ribbons.
Add the sesame oil, white pepper and the green onion tops.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lasagna Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the beef with the onion for about 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, Italian seasoning and tomato paste.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Scatter in the broken lasagna and press it under the liquid, then pour the tomatoes on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir, season, and top each bowl with ricotta, mozzarella and basil.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Borscht
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 4 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the beets, cabbage, potatoes and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the vinegar, season, and serve with sour cream and dill.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Stew
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Toss the beef in the flour, salt and pepper. Heat the oil and brown the beef in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, then set aside. Cook the onion for 3 minutes, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste.

Pour in the stock and worcestershire sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the beef with the thyme and bay leaves, and put the potatoes and carrots on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 35 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Discard the bay leaves, stir in the peas and leave for 2 minutes.
Season; if you want it thicker, simmer on Sauté for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Chili
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the beef, breaking it up, for 5 minutes. Add the onion and pepper and cook 3 minutes, then the garlic and spices.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the beans, then spoon the tomatoes and tomato paste on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir well, season, and serve with cheddar and sour cream.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the zucchini, beans and corn, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season with salt and lime and serve with sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Instant Pot White Chicken Chili
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and poblanos for 4 minutes, then the garlic, cumin and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken, beans and corn.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken, stir in the cream cheese until melted, then add lime juice, salt and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Turkey Chili
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the turkey for 5 minutes, then the onion, pepper, garlic and spices for 2 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the beans and sweet potato, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chickpea Curry
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chickpeas, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the coconut milk and spinach on Sauté until hot and wilted.
Season and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Butter Chicken
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt 1 tbsp of the butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken and pour the tomatoes on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the chicken, blend the sauce smooth, then return the chicken.
Stir in the rest of the butter, the cream and honey, season and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and paste for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken and pour the tomatoes over the top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 7 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the yogurt and cream on Sauté until hot without boiling.
Season and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Dal Tadka
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the split peas, turmeric, tomato and 1 tsp salt and stir.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Whisk the dal to break it down; thin with hot water if needed.
For the tadka, heat the ghee in a small pan, fry the cumin and mustard seeds until they pop, add the garlic and chilies until golden, and pour over the dal.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chana Masala

ingredients.name: Dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger, chili and spices for 1 minute.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked chickpeas and the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 18 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce, season, and finish with lemon and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Thai Green Curry with Chicken
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Select Sauté, add the pepper, beans, coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 4 minutes.
Finish with basil and lime juice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Massaman Beef Curry
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the beef in batches, about 6 minutes in all, then stir in the curry paste for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add half the coconut milk, then the potatoes and onion on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the rest of the coconut milk, the fish sauce and sugar on Sauté.
Serve topped with peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lamb Rogan Josh
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the ghee and brown the lamb in batches, then cook the onion for 3 minutes and the garlic, ginger, spices and tomato paste for 1 minute.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the lamb.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the yogurt on the Keep Warm setting, season, and serve with cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Adobo
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.

Pour in the water, soy sauce and vinegar and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the bay leaves, peppercorns and sugar and turn the chicken skin-side up.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the chicken, simmer the sauce on Sauté for 5 minutes to reduce, and spoon it over.
Scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Carnitas

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut in large chunks

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Rub the pork with the spices and 2 tsp salt. Heat the oil and brown the pork on two sides in batches.

Pour in the stock and the juice of the oranges and lime and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the onion, garlic and bay leaves.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 60 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the pork, spread on a tray, spoon over some cooking liquid and grill for 5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pulled Pork
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Rub the pork with the sugar, spices, salt and pepper. Heat the oil and brown the pork in batches.

Pour in the water and vinegar and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the pork.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 60 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the pork, drain off most of the liquid and stir in the barbecue sauce.
Serve in buns.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Barbacoa
steps: Pour in the stock and vinegar, blended with the chipotles, garlic, onion, spices and lime juice and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the beef, season with salt and tuck in the bay leaves.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 60 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the beef in the sauce and serve in tortillas.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pot Roast
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Season the roast well. Heat the oil and brown it for 4 to 5 minutes per side, then set aside. Cook the onion for 2 minutes and stir in the garlic and tomato paste.

Pour in the stock and worcestershire sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the roast with the rosemary.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 60 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Add the potatoes and carrots, then pressure cook on High for 4 more minutes and quick release.
Lift everything out, and thicken the liquid on Sauté with the cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water to make gravy.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Short Ribs
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the ribs in batches.

Pour in the water and soy sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the sugar, pear, garlic and ginger and return the ribs.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 40 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the ribs, simmer the sauce on Sauté until glossy, about 5 minutes, and stir in the sesame oil.
Spoon over the ribs and scatter with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the chicken in batches, then cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms for 4 minutes and the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the wine and let it bubble for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the chicken, add the oregano, and pour the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the olives and basil and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Goulash
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the beef in batches. Cook the onions for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic, paprika, caraway and tomato paste for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the beef and add the pepper and potatoes.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Coq au Vin
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Cook the bacon until crisp, then brown the chicken in the fat in batches. Cook the mushrooms and onions for 3 minutes, then stir in the garlic, flour and tomato paste.

Pour in the wine and stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the chicken and bacon with the thyme.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Simmer the sauce on Sauté for 5 minutes if you want it thicker, season, and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lentil and Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic and spices.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils and sweet potatoes, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the kale until wilted, add lemon juice and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Irish Lamb Stew
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Toss the lamb in flour, salt and pepper and brown it in batches in the oil. Cook the onion for 3 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the lamb and add the potatoes, carrots, leeks and thyme.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season and add the parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Korma
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the ghee and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and paste for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the almonds, cream and sugar on Sauté and simmer 2 minutes.
Season and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Jamaican Curry Chicken
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Toss the chicken with the curry powder, allspice and salt. Heat the oil and brown it lightly, then add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the thyme, the whole scotch bonnet (do not burst it), the potatoes and carrots.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Remove the pepper and thyme stems, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ethiopian Misir Wot
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onions slowly for 8 to 10 minutes until deep golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger, berbere and tomato paste for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir well and season; it should be thick and spoonable.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Black-Eyed Peas with Greens
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and celery for 4 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked black-eyed peas and ham hock.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Remove the hock and pick off the meat.
Stir in the greens on Sauté until tender, about 5 minutes, add the meat back with the vinegar and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Red Beans and Rice

ingredients.name: Dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the sausage in the oil, then add the onion, pepper and celery for 4 minutes and the garlic and seasoning for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked beans and bay leaves.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Mash some beans against the side to make it creamy, season, and serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pinto Beans from Dry
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked beans, onion, garlic, jalapeno, cumin and oil.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 45 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Discard the onion and jalapeno, season with salt and let the beans sit in their liquid for 10 minutes to absorb it.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chickpeas from Dry
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked chickpeas, bay leaf and garlic.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 45 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Drain, keeping some liquid for hummus if you like, and salt the chickpeas while warm. (Soaked overnight, cook them for 15 minutes instead).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Black Beans from Dry
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked beans, onion, garlic, bay leaf and cumin.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Discard the onion and bay leaf and season. (Soaked overnight, cook them for 8 minutes instead).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Refried Beans
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked beans, onion, garlic, jalapeno and cumin.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 45 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Ladle off and keep most of the liquid, then mash the beans with the oil, adding liquid back until creamy.
Season with salt.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cuban Black Bean Stew

ingredients.name: Dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the garlic, cumin and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked beans and bay leaves.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir in the vinegar, mash some of the beans, season, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegetable Korma
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and paste.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes, carrots and cauliflower.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the coconut milk, peas and cashews on Sauté until hot, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Sausage and Lentil Stew
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the sausage slices in the oil, then cook the onion, carrot and celery for 4 minutes and the garlic for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils and thyme.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the mustard and parsley and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Tuscan White Bean Stew

ingredients.name: Dried cannellini beans, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat 2 tbsp oil and cook the onion and carrot for 4 minutes, then the garlic and rosemary.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked beans and the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir in the kale on Sauté until tender, season, and finish with the remaining oil and parmesan.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Curry with Potatoes
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and curry powder.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken and potatoes, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the coconut milk, season, and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Japanese Curry
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the chicken lightly, then cook the onion for 2 minutes.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the carrots and potatoes.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Turn the pot to Keep Warm, break in the curry roux and stir until it melts and thickens, then add the ketchup.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Chile Verde
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Season the pork and brown it in batches in the oil, then cook the onion, garlic and cumin for 2 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the pork and add the poblanos and salsa verde on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season, add lime and cilantro, and serve with warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Instant Pot White Rice
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear, then add it to the pot with the salt and butter and level it out.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff with a fork before serving. Use a 1:1 rice to water ratio by volume (a little more water for softer rice).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Brown Rice
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Rinse the rice and add it with the salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 22 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Jasmine Rice
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Rinse the rice until the water is nearly clear and add it with a pinch of salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff gently and serve.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Basmati Rice
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Rinse the rice, then add it with the bay leaf, cardamom, ghee and salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Remove the whole spices and fluff.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Quinoa
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Rinse the quinoa well in a fine sieve to remove its bitter coating, then add it with the salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 1 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff and add a squeeze of lemon if you like.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Steel-Cut Oats
steps: Pour in the water and milk and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the oats, salt and cinnamon; do not fill above the half line because oats foam.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir well; they thicken as they stand. Serve with maple syrup and blueberries.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mushroom Risotto
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion and mushrooms for 5 minutes, then the garlic. Stir in the rice for 1 minute until coated, add the wine and stir until it is absorbed.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir for 1 minute until creamy, then beat in the parmesan, season, and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lemon Pea Risotto
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the shallot for 2 minutes. Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then the wine until absorbed.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the peas, lemon zest and juice, and parmesan, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Spanish Rice
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and toast the rice and onion, stirring, for 4 to 5 minutes until the rice is light golden. Add the garlic and cumin.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Spoon the tomato sauce on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Biryani
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the ghee and fry the onion until golden, about 6 minutes; set half aside. Add the chicken, garlic, ginger and masala and cook 2 minutes, then stir in the yogurt.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Layer the rice on top, scatter with salt and half the herbs, and press it under the liquid without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff gently and top with the reserved onions, the rest of the herbs and fried onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Rice
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Season and brown the chicken on one side in the oil, then set aside. Cook the onion for 2 minutes with the garlic, paprika and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the rice, and lay the chicken on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the peas, cover for 2 minutes, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Arroz con Pollo
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Season and brown the chicken in the oil, then cook the onion and pepper for 4 minutes with the garlic and spices.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the rice, nestle in the chicken and spoon the tomato sauce on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the olives and peas and leave covered for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Jambalaya
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the sausage and chicken in the oil, then cook the vegetables for 3 minutes and the garlic and seasoning for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the rice, then pour the tomatoes over the top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 7 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the shrimp, replace the lid and leave for 5 minutes until pink.
Scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Fried-Style Rice
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat 1 tbsp oil, scramble the eggs and set aside, then cook the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rice and level it out.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the frozen vegetables, soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and green onions on Sauté with the rest of the oil for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mexican Quinoa Bowl
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion, garlic and spices for 3 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the quinoa, beans and corn.
