Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 1 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff, season, and top with avocado, lime and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Farro with Mushrooms
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the shallot and mushrooms for 4 minutes with the thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the farro.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Drain off any extra liquid, stir in the parmesan and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Polenta
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Select Sauté, bring the water to a simmer with 1 tsp salt, and whisk in the polenta in a thin stream. Turn the pot off.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Whisk until smooth, then beat in the butter and parmesan and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Congee
steps: Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rice and ginger.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir until silky, thinning with water if you like, and season.
Serve with green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil and white pepper.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Coconut Rice
steps: Pour in the water and coconut milk and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rice, sugar and salt and stir.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff gently.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mujadara
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onions, stirring often, for 12 to 15 minutes until deep brown; lift out half for the top. Stir in the cumin.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils and rice with 1 tsp salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff, top with the reserved onions, and serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the beef with the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then the garlic and seasoning.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Scatter in the broken spaghetti in a criss-cross pattern so it doesn't clump, press it under the water, then pour the passata on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir well and leave for 2 minutes to thicken, then season and serve with parmesan. (Use half the box's cooking time as a guide for other pasta).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mac and Cheese
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the macaroni, butter, mustard powder and 1 tsp salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the milk, then the cheeses a handful at a time until smooth. Season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Penne Arrabbiata
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the garlic and pepper flakes for 1 minute until fragrant.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the penne and press it under, then pour the passata on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir, season, and finish with basil and pecorino.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the chicken in the oil for 3 minutes, then the garlic and seasoning.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the penne and sun-dried tomatoes and press under the liquid.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the cream, spinach and parmesan until wilted and creamy, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Stroganoff
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the beef in the oil in batches, then cook the onion and mushrooms for 4 minutes and the garlic for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and worcestershire sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the beef and add the noodles, pressing them under the liquid.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the sour cream and mustard, season, and add parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then the garlic and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the beans and pasta, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir, season and serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Lo Mein
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the chicken in the oil for 3 minutes, then the garlic and ginger.

Pour in the stock, soy sauce and oyster sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Break the noodles in half and lay them on top, then the pepper and snow peas.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Toss everything with the sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegetable Lentil Bolognese
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then the garlic and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils and pour the passata on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir, season and serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Hard-Boiled Eggs (5-5-5)
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Put the trivet in the pot and set the eggs on it.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Quick release the remaining pressure and move the eggs straight into a bowl of iced water for 5 minutes, then peel. (Cook 3 minutes for jammy yolks).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Egg Bites
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.

Blend the eggs, cottage cheese, cheese and seasoning until smooth. Butter a silicone egg-bite mould, divide the bacon and chives between the cups and pour in the eggs. Cover with foil and lower onto the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out carefully and turn the bites out of the mould.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Shakshuka
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices.

Pour in the tomatoes and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Season, make four wells and crack an egg into each.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on Low for 1 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
If the whites are still loose, cover with a lid on Sauté-Low for 2 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Breakfast Casserole
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the sausage with the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then transfer to a buttered 1.5 litre baking dish that fits in the pot, with the hash browns.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cheese and seasoning, pour over the filling, cover with foil and lower onto the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Rest 5 minutes and slice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the oats, apples, cinnamon and salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir in maple syrup and top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Whole Chicken
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Rub the chicken with oil, spices, salt and pepper, put the lemon inside, and brown it breast-side down for 4 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Set the trivet in the pot and put the chicken on it breast-side up.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 24 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Check the thickest part of the thigh reads 74 °C (165 °F); rest 10 minutes. Grill for a few minutes if you want crisp skin. Allow about 6 minutes per 450 g (1 lb) of chicken.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Shredded Chicken
steps: Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Season the chicken and add it in a single layer.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred with two forks and moisten with some of the liquid. Use for tacos, salads and sandwiches.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Pour in the stock, soy sauce and vinegar and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the honey and garlic and add the chicken.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 9 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the chicken, thicken the sauce on Sauté with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water, then return the chicken.
Top with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Pour in the water, soy sauce and mirin and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the sugar, ginger and garlic and add the chicken.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Slice the chicken, thicken the sauce on Sauté with the cornstarch slurry, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Salsa Chicken
steps: Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken with the spices and salt, and pour the salsa on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred and serve in tortillas.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Kalua-Style Pork
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Cook the bacon until the fat runs, then lay the pork on top, cut in 3 pieces and rubbed with the salt.

Pour in the water and liquid smoke and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 90 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the pork. Add the cabbage to the liquid and pressure cook on High for 3 minutes, quick release, and serve with the pork.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Tenderloin with Apples
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Season and brown the pork all over in the oil, about 5 minutes, then set aside and cook the onion for 2 minutes.

Pour in the cider and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the apples, mustard and thyme and set the pork on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Check the pork reads 63 °C (145 °F), rest it, and thicken the sauce on Sauté with the cornstarch slurry.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ribs
steps: Pour in the apple juice and vinegar and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Rub the ribs with sugar, spices, salt and pepper, and stand them on the trivet curled around the pot.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill or bake at 220 °C for 5 to 8 minutes until sticky.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Corned Beef and Cabbage

ingredients.name: Corned beef brisket, with spice packet

steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Set the brisket on the trivet fat side up with the onion, garlic and spices.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 90 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the beef to rest. Add the vegetables to the liquid, pressure cook on High for 3 minutes and quick release.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the vegetables, butter and mustard.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Salmon with Lemon and Dill
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Set the trivet in the pot, lay the salmon on it skin-side down, season, and top with lemon slices and dill.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Top each fillet with a little butter. Cook 2 minutes for thin fillets or 4 minutes from frozen.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Shrimp Boil
steps: Pour in the water with the seasoning and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes, corn and sausage.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Add the shrimp, close the lid and leave for 4 to 5 minutes until pink.
Melt the butter with the garlic and lemon juice and pour over everything.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mussels in White Wine
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the shallots and garlic for 2 minutes.

Pour in the wine and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the mussels.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 1 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Discard any that stay closed, stir in the cream and parsley, and serve with baguette.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Sloppy Joes
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the beef with the onion and pepper for 6 minutes, then add the garlic.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Spoon the ketchup, worcestershire sauce, sugar and mustard on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir, simmer on Sauté until thick, season and pile into buns.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Swedish Meatballs
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, allspice, salt and pepper and roll into 24 balls. Melt the butter and brown them in batches.

Pour in the stock and worcestershire sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return all the meatballs.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the meatballs. Whisk the flour into the sour cream, stir into the liquid on Sauté until thick, and return the meatballs with parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mashed Potatoes
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes with 1 tsp salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Drain, then mash with the butter and warm milk and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Baked-Style Potatoes
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Prick the potatoes and set them on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Split and fill with butter, sour cream, chives and salt. (Large potatoes may need 18 to 20 minutes).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Corn on the Cob
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stand the corn on the trivet (break the cobs in half to fit).
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 2 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Spread with butter and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Steamed Artichokes
steps: Pour in the water with half the lemon squeezed in and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stand the artichokes on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Serve with mayonnaise mixed with garlic and lemon juice. (Medium artichokes 9 to 12 minutes, large up to 15).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beets
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Set the whole beets on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 20 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Rub off the skins under cold water, slice, and dress with oil, vinegar and salt. (Small beets 15 minutes, large 25 to 30).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Spaghetti Squash
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Put the squash halves on the trivet, cut-side up.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 7 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Scrape out the strands with a fork and toss with butter, parmesan and seasoning.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Collard Greens
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Cook the bacon in the oil until crisp, then the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Pack in the greens with the pepper flakes.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 20 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the vinegar and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Glazed Carrots
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the carrots in a steamer basket.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Drain, then toss on Sauté with the butter and sugar for 2 minutes until glossy and add parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ratatouille
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes, then the garlic and herbs.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the eggplant, zucchini and pepper, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Simmer on Sauté for 5 minutes to thicken, season and stir in basil.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cabbage and Sausage
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the sausage in the oil, then cook the onion for 2 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the cabbage and caraway.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the vinegar and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Green Beans with Potatoes
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Cook the bacon until crisp, then the onion for 2 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes and green beans.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Season and serve with the cooking juices.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Sweet Potatoes
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Set the whole sweet potatoes on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 16 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Split and top with butter, cinnamon and salt. (Thin ones 12 minutes, very large ones up to 22).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cauliflower Mash
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Put the florets in a steamer basket with the garlic.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Drain and blend or mash with the butter and parmesan, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Applesauce
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the apples, cinnamon and a squeeze of lemon.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Mash or blend to your liking and sweeten if needed.

recipes.title: Instant Pot New York Cheesecake
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.

Mix the crumbs and butter and press into a 7-inch (18 cm) springform pan. Beat the cream cheese and sugar, then the sour cream, flour, vanilla and zest, then the eggs on low just until smooth. Pour over the base, cover with foil and lower onto the trivet using a foil sling.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 35 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out, cool to room temperature and chill for at least 4 hours before slicing.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Rice Pudding
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rice, 500 ml of the milk, the sugar and salt and stir.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Whisk the eggs with the rest of the milk, the cream and vanilla, stir in, and cook on Sauté, stirring, until it just boils.
Stir in raisins and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chocolate Lava Cakes
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Melt the chocolate and butter. Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar until pale, fold in the chocolate, flour and salt, and pour into four buttered ramekins dusted with cocoa. Set them on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 9 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Run a knife round and turn out onto plates at once.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Flan
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Melt the sugar in a small pan until amber and pour it into a 1.5 litre dish that fits the pot. Blend the milks, eggs and vanilla, pour over the caramel, cover with foil and set on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 9 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Cool, chill for 6 hours, then turn out onto a plate.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Poached Pears in Red Wine
steps: Pour in the wine and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Stir in the sugar, cinnamon, zest and cloves and stand the pears in the liquid.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the pears and simmer the syrup on Sauté until reduced by half, about 10 minutes, then spoon over.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Bread Pudding
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.

Butter a 1.5 litre dish that fits the pot. Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon, soak the bread and raisins in it for 10 minutes, then pour into the dish, cover with foil and set on the trivet.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Brown the top under the grill for a few minutes if you like.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Tapioca Pudding
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the tapioca, sugar and salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Whisk the egg with the milk, stir in, and cook on Sauté, stirring, until it boils and thickens.
Stir in vanilla.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Stock
steps: Pour in the water, keeping below the max fill line and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the bones, vegetables, bay and peppercorns.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 60 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Strain, cool and skim the fat. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Bone Broth
steps: Pour in the water, keeping below the max fill line and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the bones, vegetables, vinegar and bay leaves.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 120 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Strain, chill and lift off the fat.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegetable Stock
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the vegetables, parsley and bay.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Strain and season lightly.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Marinara Sauce
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Pour the tomatoes and paste on top without stirring, and add the oregano and sugar.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the basil, blend if you like it smooth, and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Homemade Yogurt
steps: This uses the Yogurt program, not pressure. Pour the milk into the inner pot, close the lid (the valve position does not matter), press Yogurt and adjust to Boil; it takes about 30 minutes and beeps when the milk reaches about 82 °C (180 °F).
Cool the milk to 43 °C (110 °F), about 1 hour, or faster with the inner pot in a sink of cold water.
Whisk a ladle of the milk into the starter yogurt, then whisk it all back into the pot.
Press Yogurt, set 8 hours, and leave it undisturbed.
Chill for at least 4 hours; strain through a cloth for thick Greek-style yogurt. Serve with honey and granola.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Sweet Potato Black Bean Chili
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic and spices.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the sweet potatoes and beans, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season with lime and salt, and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Coconut Lentil Curry
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and curry powder.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the coconut milk and spinach on Sauté, add lime and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Aloo Gobi
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds until they crackle, then cook the onion for 3 minutes and the garlic, ginger and spices for 30 seconds.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower and tomato with salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 2 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir gently, cook on Sauté for 2 minutes to dry slightly, and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Saag Chickpeas
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes, then the garlic, ginger, chili and spice.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chickpeas and pack the spinach on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Blend about half the mixture to a sauce, stir in the coconut milk and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Rajma

ingredients.name: Dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and spices.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the soaked beans and pour the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Mash a few beans, season, and serve over rice with cilantro. (Kidney beans must be fully soft; cook longer if not).

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegan Mushroom Stroganoff
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and mushrooms for 6 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.

Pour in the stock and soy sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the pasta and press it under the liquid.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the cashew cream and mustard, season, and add parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Quinoa Vegetable Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then the garlic and cumin.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the quinoa and zucchini, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 1 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the kale until wilted and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Split Pea Dal with Spinach
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil, fry the cumin seeds, then cook the onion for 3 minutes and the garlic and ginger.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the split peas and turmeric.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir in the spinach, add lemon juice and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ethiopian Cabbage and Potatoes
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes, then the garlic and spices.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the carrots and potatoes, then the cabbage on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mexican Street Corn Rice
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion for 3 minutes, then stir in the rice and chili powder.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the corn on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Fluff with the cheese, lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Tomato Lentil Soup with Coconut
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils, then the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend, stir in the coconut milk and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Season and brown the chicken in the oil, then the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and the juice of one lemon and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes and set the chicken on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season, add the second lemon in wedges, and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Moroccan Lamb Tagine
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the lamb in batches in the oil, then the onion for 3 minutes and the garlic and spices for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Return the lamb with the chickpeas, apricots and honey.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season and top with almonds and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Toss the chicken with the spice, salt, half the oil and lemon juice. Heat the remaining oil and brown it on one side.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with cucumber, tomato and tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Ramen
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Brown the pork in the oil, then the garlic and ginger.

Pour in the stock and soy sauce and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Whisk in the miso off the heat, and ladle over the noodles with the pork, halved eggs, green onions and nori.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pho-Style Beef Noodle Soup
steps: Pour in the water, keeping below the max line and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the bones, brisket, onion, ginger and spices.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 45 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Lift out the brisket and slice thinly, strain the broth, and season with fish sauce and sugar.
Pour over the noodles and brisket and serve with herbs, sprouts and lime.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chinese Braised Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Soy sauce, ideally 1 tbsp of it dark soy

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the pork, then add the sugar and cook until it caramelises, about 2 minutes. Stir in the garlic and ginger.

Pour in the water, soy sauces and wine and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the star anise.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Reduce the sauce on Sauté until sticky and scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Congee with Ginger
steps: Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rice, chicken and half the ginger.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Shred the chicken into the congee, season, and top with ginger, green onions, soy and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Hummus
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked chickpeas and baking soda (it makes them extra soft).
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 45 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Drain, keeping some liquid. Blend the warm chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt, adding cooking liquid until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Baba Ganoush
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and lightly brown the eggplant for 4 minutes, then add the garlic.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 3 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Drain well and blend with tahini, lemon juice and salt.
Top with paprika and parsley.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the banana and walnuts, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the honey (the cornmeal goes in with the flour, and use only 1 cup flour), then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the bran (soak it in the milk for 10 minutes first), raisins and molasses, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Zucchini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
