Fold in the zucchini, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Carrot Raisin Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the carrot and raisins, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Strawberry Oat Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the strawberries and oats, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Peach Streusel Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the peaches; rub the cold butter with the brown sugar and 3 tbsp flour for the topping, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Morning Glory Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spice in a large bowl. Spoon the flour into the cup and level it rather than scooping, or weigh it (1 cup is about 125 g).
Whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla in a jug, pour into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.
Fold in the carrot, apple, raisins, coconut and pecans, then divide between the cases.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until risen and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Macadamia Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the white chocolate and macadamias.
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 9 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: M&M-Style Candy Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the candies, pressing a few extra on top of each ball.
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 9 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Cranberry Oat White Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the oats, cranberries and white chocolate (use 1 3/4 cups flour).
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pecan Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the butterscotch chips and pecans.
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 9 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Toffee Chocolate Chunk Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the toffee and chocolate.
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 9 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Monster Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the peanut butter (beat it in with the butter), then the oats, chips and candies (use 1 1/2 cups flour).
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt and mix in on low speed until just combined; spoon and level the flour, or weigh it.
Stir in the oats, chips, coconut and pecans (use 2 cups flour).
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches (5 cm) apart and bake for 11 to 13 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Makes about 36 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Molasses Spice Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Beat the butter and brown sugar, then the egg and molasses.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, spices and salt.
Roll into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar.
Bake for 9 to 10 minutes; they should still look soft.
Makes about 30 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies for Cutting
steps: Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt, divide in two discs and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C). Roll to 1/4 inch (6 mm) on a floured surface and cut out shapes.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until just set; cool before icing.
Makes about 30 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cookies
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg and molasses.
Mix in the flour, spices, baking soda and salt, wrap and chill for 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C), roll to 1/4 inch and cut out.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes about 30 pieces (listed here as 24 servings so scaling stays simple).

recipes.title: Lemon Loaf Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) loaf pan.

Rub the zest into the sugar, then whisk in the eggs, milk, oil and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt. After baking, drizzle with the powdered sugar mixed with the remaining lemon juice.
Bake for about 50 minutes until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Southern Skillet Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 425 °F (220 °C).
Heat a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with 1 tbsp butter in the oven. Whisk the dry ingredients, then the eggs, buttermilk and remaining butter, and stir together. Pour into the hot skillet.
Bake for about 22 minutes until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) loaf pan.
Pour the boiling water over the dates and baking soda and leave 15 minutes. Beat the butter, sugar and egg, stir in the dates and liquid, then the flour, salt and nuts.
Bake for about 55 minutes until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Swirl Quick Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then stir in the egg, milk and oil. Pour half in the pan, sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon, add the rest and swirl with a knife.
Bake for about 50 minutes until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Blueberry Lemon Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs, milk and zest. Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the blueberries tossed in 1 tbsp flour.
Bake for about 60 minutes until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) loaf pan.
Stir the flour, sugar and beer to a sticky batter, spread in the pan and pour the butter over the top.
Bake for about 50 minutes until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Classic Yellow Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and line two 9-inch (23 cm) round pans.
Beat the butter and sugar for 4 minutes until pale, then the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt and add in three parts, alternating with the milk.
Divide between the pans and bake for 28 to 32 minutes.
Cool completely before frosting.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 10x15-inch (25x38 cm) sheet pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, soda and salt. Bring half the butter, half the cocoa and the water to a boil and pour over; stir in the buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes.
Meanwhile melt the rest of the butter and cocoa with the milk, beat in the powdered sugar and pecans, and pour over the warm cake.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and line two 9-inch pans.
Whisk the eggs, oil and sugars, then fold in the flour, soda, salt and cinnamon, then the carrots and walnuts.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes and cool.
Beat the cream cheese and butter, then the powdered sugar and vanilla, and frost.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 325 °F (165 °C) and grease a 10-inch tube pan.
Beat the butter and sugar for 5 minutes, then the eggs one at a time.
Whisk the cake flour, baking powder and salt and add alternately with the sour cream and vanilla.
Bake for 65 to 75 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Applesauce Spice Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg and applesauce.
Fold in the dry ingredients and raisins.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake (Egg-Free Chocolate Cake)
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Whisk the dry ingredients in an 8-inch square pan, make three wells and pour the oil into one, the vinegar into another and the vanilla into the third.
Pour the water over and stir until smooth.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. This cake contains no eggs, milk or butter.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake with Streusel
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 9-inch square pan.
Mix the brown sugar, cinnamon, pecans and 1/3 cup of the flour with 3 tbsp of the butter for the streusel.
Beat the rest of the butter with the sugar, then the eggs, sour cream and vanilla, and fold in the remaining flour, baking powder and salt.
Spread in the pan, scatter the streusel over and bake for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and line an 8-inch square pan.
Melt the butter, stir in the sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder, then the chips.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until the top is set but a toothpick still shows moist crumbs.
Cool fully before cutting.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Jam Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and line a 9-inch square pan.
Mix the flour, oats, sugar, soda, salt and butter to a crumble.
Press two-thirds into the pan, spread with jam and scatter the rest over.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes and cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Seven-Layer Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Mix the butter and crumbs and press into a 9x13-inch pan.
Layer the chips, coconut and pecans, then pour the condensed milk evenly over.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden; cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars with Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease a 10x15-inch pan.
Whisk the eggs, pumpkin, sugar and oil, then fold in the dry ingredients.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes and cool.
Beat the cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar and spread on top.

recipes.title: Angel Food Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C). Do not grease the tube pan.
Sift the cake flour with half the sugar twice.
Whisk the whites, cream of tartar and salt to soft peaks, then add the rest of the sugar gradually to stiff glossy peaks and the vanilla.
Fold in the flour mixture in four parts, spoon into the pan and bake for 38 to 42 minutes.
Cool upside down in the pan.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and butter, pour in and stir just until combined; leave lumpy and rest 5 minutes.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a lightly buttered griddle over medium heat until bubbles form, about 2 minutes, then flip for 1 minute.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Flaky Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 450 °F (230 °C).
Whisk the dry ingredients and grate or cut in the cold butter until in pea-sized pieces.
Stir in the buttermilk to a shaggy dough, pat out, fold in thirds twice and pat to 3/4 inch.
Cut straight down with a floured cutter without twisting and bake touching on a sheet for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Drop Biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 450 °F (230 °C).
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the butter and milk just until combined.
Drop 1/4-cup mounds onto a lined sheet and bake for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C).
Whisk the dry ingredients and zest, and cut in the butter.
Whisk the cream and egg, stir in, then fold in the blueberries.
Pat into a round, cut 8 wedges and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease an 8-inch square dish.
Mix the oats, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Whisk the milk, eggs, butter and vanilla and stir in, then fold in the blueberries.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Popovers
steps: Heat the oven to 425 °F (220 °C) with a greased popover or muffin tin inside.
Whisk everything to a smooth batter.
Fill the hot cups halfway and bake for 20 minutes, then reduce to 350 °F (175 °C) for 15 minutes without opening the door.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Crepes
steps: Blend everything except the spread until smooth and rest 15 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered 8-inch pan over medium heat, pour in 3 tbsp batter and swirl thin.
Cook 1 minute until the edges lift, flip and cook 30 seconds.
Fill with spread or fruit.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and line a muffin tin.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs, sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Layer the batter with the brown sugar and cinnamon in the cases and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: All-Butter Pie Crust
steps: Whisk the flour, salt and sugar and cut in the butter until in pea-sized pieces.
Sprinkle in the ice water a tablespoon at a time, tossing, until the dough holds when squeezed.
Press into a disc, wrap and chill for at least 1 hour before rolling. Makes one 9-inch crust.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 425 °F (220 °C).
Whisk the pumpkin, sugar, salt, spices and eggs, then the evaporated milk.
Pour into the crust and bake for 15 minutes, then reduce to 350 °F (175 °C) for 40 to 50 minutes until a knife comes out clean near the centre.
Cool for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Whisk the syrup, eggs, sugar, butter and vanilla, stir in the pecans and pour into the crust.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes until set with a slight wobble, covering the edges with foil if they darken.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C).
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice in a 9-inch square dish.
Rub the flour, oats, brown sugar and butter together and scatter over.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the fruit bubbles.

recipes.title: Berry Crumble Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Mix the flour, 1 cup of the sugar, the baking powder and salt, cut in the butter and stir in the egg to a crumbly dough.
Press half into the pan.
Toss the berries with the remaining 1/2 cup sugar and the cornstarch, spread over and crumble the rest of the dough on top.
Bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie

ingredients.name: Limes, zested and juiced (1/2 cup juice)

steps: Heat the oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Press the crumbs, sugar and butter into a 9-inch pie dish and bake for 10 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk, yolks, lime juice and zest, pour in and bake for 15 minutes.
Chill for 3 hours and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Cherry Hand Pies
steps: Make the pastry by cutting the butter into the flour and salt and adding the water; chill 1 hour.
Simmer the cherries, sugar and cornstarch until thick and cool.
Roll the pastry, cut 16 rectangles, fill half with cherries, cover, crimp and brush with egg.
Bake at 400 °F (200 °C) for 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie
steps: Whisk the sugar, flour and salt in a saucepan, then the milk and yolks, and cook over medium heat, stirring, until thick and bubbling.
Off the heat stir in the butter and vanilla.
Layer the bananas in the crust, pour over the custard and chill for 4 hours.
Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
steps: Toss the beef in the flour, salt and pepper. Put everything in the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 5 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Discard the bay leaves and season.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Put everything except the lime, chips and avocado in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred the chicken, add lime and salt, and top with chips and avocado.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Chicken
steps: Put the onion in the slow cooker, add the chicken and pour over the sauce mixed with the sugar, vinegar and paprika.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred the chicken in the sauce and pile into buns.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chili con Carne
steps: Brown the beef with the onion in the oil in a frying pan, then tip into the slow cooker with everything else.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 4 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas
steps: Rub the pork with the spices and 2 tsp salt and put it in the slow cooker with the onion, garlic and the orange and lime juice.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 5 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred, then crisp under the grill for 5 minutes and serve in tortillas.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Butter Chicken
steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, spices and tomatoes in the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Stir in the butter and cream for the last 15 minutes, season, and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lentil Soup
steps: Put everything except the spinach and lemon in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 4 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Stir in the spinach to wilt, add lemon juice and season.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
steps: Rub the pork with sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt and set it on the onion in the slow cooker with the vinegar.
Cover and cook on Low for 10 hours or on High for 6 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred, drain most of the liquid, stir in the barbecue sauce and serve in buns.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Curry
steps: Put everything except the peas and cilantro in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Stir in the peas for the last 15 minutes and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Ragu
steps: Season the beef and put it in the slow cooker with the vegetables, garlic, wine, tomatoes, paste and bay leaves.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 5 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred the beef into the sauce and toss with cooked pappardelle and parmesan.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Put everything except the noodles and parsley in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours or on High for 4 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred the chicken, add the noodles and cook on High for 20 minutes, then add parsley and season.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Split Pea Soup
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 4 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Pull the meat off the hock, return it and season.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Salsa Verde Pork
steps: Put the pork, salsa, onion, garlic and cumin in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 5 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Shred, add lime and cilantro, and serve in tortillas.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Minestrone
steps: Put everything except the pasta and parmesan in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours or on High for 4 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Add the pasta and cook on High for 20 minutes, then season and top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
steps: Put the beef, stock, soy sauce, sugar, garlic and sesame oil in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water and the broccoli and cook on High for 30 minutes; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Jambalaya
steps: Put everything except the shrimp and rice in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Add the shrimp for the last 20 minutes on High, then stir in the cooked rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Swedish Meatballs
steps: Put the meatballs, stock, worcestershire and onion in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Whisk the flour into the sour cream, stir in for the last 20 minutes, and serve over noodles with parsley.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Mexican Rice and Beans
steps: Put everything except the cheese in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 3 hours or on High for 2 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Fluff and top with cheese.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Oatmeal
steps: Grease the slow cooker well and add everything.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours or on High for 4 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Stir and serve with extra milk.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Apple Butter
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 10 hours or on High for 6 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Blend smooth, then cook uncovered on High for 1 hour to thicken. Keeps 3 weeks in the fridge.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Hot Chocolate
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker and whisk.
Cover and cook on Low for 2 hours or on High for 1 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Whisk well and keep on Warm for serving.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lamb Shanks
steps: Brown the seasoned shanks in the oil in a frying pan, then put them in the slow cooker with everything else.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 5 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Lift out the shanks and reduce the liquid in a saucepan to a gravy.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Ratatouille
steps: Put everything except the basil in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or on High for 3 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Season and stir in basil.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Baked Beans

ingredients.name: Dried navy beans, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Boil the soaked beans hard in fresh water for 10 minutes, drain, then put them in the slow cooker with everything else.
Cover and cook on Low for 10 hours or on High for 6 hours, until tender. Slow cookers vary, so check toward the end.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Wings
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Pat the wings very dry and toss with the baking powder, garlic powder, paprika and salt.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 24 minutes, turning them halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Toss in the hot sauce mixed with butter.

recipes.title: Air Fryer French Fries
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 380 °F (195 °C) for 3 minutes.
Soak the potato sticks in cold water for 30 minutes, then dry very well and toss with the oil.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 20 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Season with salt straight away.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 380 °F (195 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the sticks with the cornstarch, then the oil and paprika.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 16 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Salt and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Chickpeas
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 390 °F (200 °C) for 3 minutes.
Pat the chickpeas very dry and toss with oil, spices and salt.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 15 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Cool; they crisp more as they cool.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375 °F (190 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the sprouts with oil, salt and pepper.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 14 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Toss with the balsamic and honey.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 380 °F (195 °C) for 3 minutes.
Pat the chicken dry and rub with oil, spices and seasoning.

Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 22 minutes, skin-side down for 10 minutes, then skin-side up. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Check they read 165 °F (74 °C) at the bone and rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Breaded Chicken Tenders
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Dredge the tenders in seasoned flour, then egg, then panko mixed with the spices, and mist with cooking spray.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 10 minutes, turning halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Serve with your favourite dip.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Roasted Vegetables
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 390 °F (200 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the vegetables with oil, seasoning and salt.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 14 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Fish Tacos
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Coat the fish in seasoned flour, egg and panko with chili powder and mist with oil.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 10 minutes, turning halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, sour cream and lime.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower Bites
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 390 °F (200 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the florets with oil, spices and salt.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 15 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Toss in hot sauce and return for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Potato Wedges
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the wedges with oil and seasoning.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 20 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Salt and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Apple Chips
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 300 °F (150 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the slices with cinnamon and sugar and lay in a single layer (cook in batches).
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 16 minutes, flipping every 4 minutes. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Cool on a rack until crisp.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Zucchini Fries
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Coat the sticks in flour, egg and panko mixed with parmesan, and mist with oil.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 10 minutes, turning halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Quesadillas
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375 °F (190 °C) for 3 minutes.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken and salsa, fold, and spray the outside.

Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 6 minutes, turning halfway; hold the top down with a toothpick so it doesn't fly up. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Baked Potatoes
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 40 minutes, turning halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Split and add butter and sour cream.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Churro Bites
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375 °F (190 °C) for 3 minutes.
Cut the pastry into bite-sized squares.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 8 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Brush with butter, toss in cinnamon sugar and serve with chocolate sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Egg Rolls
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 390 °F (200 °C) for 3 minutes.
Cook the pork with the garlic, add the coleslaw mix and soy sauce until wilted, cool, then roll in the wrappers and spray.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 10 minutes, turning halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Steak Bites
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400 °F (205 °C) for 3 minutes.
Toss the steak with oil, worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 8 minutes, shaking halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Toss with butter, garlic and parsley.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Falafel-Spiced Cauliflower Steaks
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 380 °F (195 °C) for 3 minutes.
Brush the cauliflower with oil and spices.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 16 minutes, turning halfway. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and parsley.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Bacon
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375 °F (190 °C) for 3 minutes.
Lay the bacon in a single layer and pour the water into the drawer under the basket to cut smoke.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 9 minutes, checking from 7 minutes. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Hard-Boiled Eggs
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 270 °F (130 °C) for 3 minutes.
Set the cold eggs in the basket.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 15 minutes, without turning. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Move straight into iced water for 5 minutes, then peel.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Garlic Bread
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 370 °F (190 °C) for 3 minutes.
Spread the bread with the butter mixed with garlic, parsley and parmesan.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket without crowding (cook in batches if needed) and air fry for 5 minutes, without turning. Smaller air fryers may need a few extra minutes.
Slice and serve hot.

recipes.title: Ginger Pork with Snow Peas
steps: Toss the pork with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt. Mix the sauce ingredients with 3 tbsp water.
Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat until smoking, add 1 tbsp oil and stir-fry the pork in a single layer for 3 to 4 minutes until browned and just cooked, then tip out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the vegetables for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the pork, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve straight away with hot rice.

steps: Toss the beef with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt. Mix the sauce ingredients with 3 tbsp water.
Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat until smoking, add 1 tbsp oil and stir-fry the beef in a single layer for 3 to 4 minutes until browned and just cooked, then tip out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the vegetables for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve straight away with hot rice.

steps: Heat the oil in a deep pan over medium heat and fry the aromatics and spices for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant (cook any onion for 5 minutes first).
Add the main ingredient and stir to coat; brown meat for 3 to 4 minutes, but add fish, shrimp, eggs or paneer later as noted below.
Pour in the liquid and the vegetables, season with salt and simmer for about 25 minutes until everything is tender (fish and shrimp need only the last 5 to 8 minutes).
Taste for salt and finish with a squeeze of lime. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Norma
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Fry the eggplant in the oil until golden, add the garlic, then the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with basil and grated ricotta salata.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Broccoli Rabe and Sausage
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Brown the sausage in the oil, add the garlic and pepper flakes, then the blanched broccoli rabe.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with pecorino.

recipes.title: Pasta Puttanesca
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Melt the anchovies in the oil with the garlic, add the tomatoes, olives, capers and pepper flakes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Melt the butter with the cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with the parmesan and nutmeg, tossing until silky.

recipes.title: Pesto Trofie with Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Cook the potatoes and beans in the pasta water, adding them before the pasta.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with the pesto and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Brown the mushrooms in the butter, add the garlic and thyme, then the cream and simmer 2 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg and half the parmesan, fill the cooked shells and set them on marinara in a dish, then top with mozzarella and bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.
Finish with the remaining parmesan and rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Singapore Noodles
steps: Cook or soak the noodles according to the packet, then drain, rinse briefly and toss with a few drops of oil so they don't stick.
Scramble the eggs and set aside; stir-fry the shrimp and pork, add the pepper and curry powder, then toss in the soaked noodles, soy and sprouts.
Toss well over the heat (or in the bowls) and finish with green onions.

recipes.title: Dan Dan Noodles
steps: Cook or soak the noodles according to the packet, then drain, rinse briefly and toss with a few drops of oil so they don't stick.
Fry the pork until crisp with 1 tbsp soy; whisk the sesame paste, chili oil, rest of the soy, vinegar and pepper in bowls with a little noodle water.
Toss well over the heat (or in the bowls) and finish with the noodles, blanched bok choy, pork and green onions.

recipes.title: Vegan Pad See Ew

ingredients.name: Soy sauce, ideally 2 tbsp of it dark soy

steps: Cook or soak the noodles according to the packet, then drain, rinse briefly and toss with a few drops of oil so they don't stick.
Fry the tofu until golden, add the garlic and broccoli stems, then the noodles, sauces and sugar, and let the noodles char a little.
Toss well over the heat (or in the bowls) and finish with white pepper.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Linguine
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Cook the shrimp in half the butter for 2 minutes, add the garlic and pepper flakes, then the wine and simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with the rest of the butter, lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.title: One-Pot Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Put the raw pasta, tomatoes, onion, garlic, half the basil, oil, water and 2 tsp salt in one wide pot and boil, stirring often, for 9 to 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the liquid has become a sauce.
Finish with the rest of the basil and parmesan and serve straight from the pot.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Pasta Primavera
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Saute the vegetables in the oil for 4 minutes with the garlic. Cook gluten-free pasta for the shortest time on the pack and rinse briefly in hot water so it doesn't stick.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and finish with lemon zest and parmesan.

recipes.title: Nigerian Jollof Rice
steps: Blend one onion with the peppers, scotch bonnet and tomatoes until smooth.
Fry the other onion, sliced, in the oil for 4 minutes, add the tomato paste and fry 3 minutes, then add the blended mixture and cook for 15 minutes until thick and the oil rises.
Stir in the curry powder, thyme, bay, salt and stock, then the rice.
Cover tightly with foil and the lid and cook on low for 25 to 30 minutes without stirring, until the rice is tender.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Groundnut Soup with Chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken with half the onion, ginger, garlic and salt in a little water for 10 minutes.
Blend the tomatoes with the rest of the onion and the pepper and add with the stock.
Whisk the peanut butter with a ladle of the hot stock until smooth and stir it in.
Simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the oil rises to the top.

recipes.title: Senegalese Chicken Yassa
steps: Marinate the chicken and onions in the lemon juice, mustard, garlic, salt and pepper for at least 2 hours.
Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onions from the marinade slowly for 20 minutes until soft and golden.
Return the chicken with the pepper, the marinade and 120 ml water, cover and simmer for 25 minutes; add the olives and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken with Preserved Lemon and Olives
steps: Rub the chicken with the onion, garlic, spices, oil and salt.
Brown it in a heavy pot, add the stock, cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
Add the preserved lemon and olives and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to reduce.
Scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Egyptian Koshari
steps: Fry the onions in the oil until deep brown and crisp, about 20 minutes, and drain.
Boil the lentils for 15 minutes, add the rice and a little of the onion oil and cook until both are tender.
Cook the pasta separately.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, cumin, vinegar, chili and salt for 15 minutes.
Layer rice and lentils, pasta and chickpeas, spoon over the sauce and top with crispy onions.

recipes.title: Tunisian Shakshuka with Merguez
steps: Brown the merguez in a deep frying pan and lift out.
Cook the onion and peppers in the fat for 8 minutes, then the garlic and harissa.
Add the tomatoes and sausage and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until the whites set; scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: South African Bobotie
steps: Soak the bread in the milk. Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Cook the onions in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices, then the beef until browned.
Squeeze the bread (keep the milk) and mix it in with the jam, lemon juice, raisins and salt; spread in a baking dish.
Beat the eggs into the reserved milk, pour over, tuck in the bay leaves and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Kenyan Sukuma Wiki
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and chili and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the greens with a pinch of salt and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Serve with ugali or rice.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Doro Wat
steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot over medium-low heat, stirring, for 15 minutes until soft and jammy, then add the butter.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and berbere for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken rubbed with lemon juice and salt, and the stock; cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Score the eggs, add them and simmer 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Peruvian Lomo Saltado

ingredients.name: Aji amarillo paste, or 1 jalapeno, sliced

steps: Season the beef and sear it in very hot oil in batches, 1 to 2 minutes, then set aside.
Stir-fry the onion and chili for 2 minutes, then the garlic and tomatoes for 1 minute.
Return the beef with the soy sauce and vinegar and toss.
Fold in the fries and cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Peruvian Aji de Gallina
steps: Poach the chicken in salted water for 15 minutes, shred it and keep 250 ml of the broth.
Soak the bread in the milk and blend with the walnuts and parmesan.
Cook the onion, garlic and aji paste in the oil for 6 minutes, add the bread mixture and broth and simmer for 5 minutes until creamy.
Stir in the chicken and serve over rice with eggs and olives.

recipes.title: Colombian Bandeja-Style Beans

ingredients.name: Dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight

steps: Boil the soaked beans hard for 10 minutes, then simmer with the carrot for 60 minutes until tender.
Fry the pork belly until crisp, then cook the onion, tomatoes, garlic, cumin and green onions in the fat for 8 minutes (this is the hogao).
Add the plantain and hogao to the beans and simmer 20 minutes more until thick.
Season and serve with rice, avocado and a fried egg.

recipes.title: Brazilian Moqueca

ingredients.name: Bell peppers, 1 red and 1 yellow, sliced
Red palm oil (dende), or more olive oil

steps: Marinate the fish with lime juice, garlic and salt for 20 minutes.
Layer half the onion, peppers and tomatoes in a wide pot with the olive oil, add the fish and cover with the rest of the vegetables.
Pour over the coconut milk and dende oil and simmer covered for 15 to 20 minutes without stirring.
Scatter with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada (Simplified)
steps: Simmer the beans in plenty of water with the bay leaves for 45 minutes.
Brown the bacon, pork and sausage in a frying pan, then the onion and garlic.
Add everything to the beans and simmer gently for 1 hour 15 minutes until the meat is tender and the broth thick.
Season and serve with rice and orange slices.

recipes.title: Argentine Chimichurri Steak
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the oregano, pepper flakes, vinegar, oil and salt; leave for 20 minutes.
Season the steak and grill or sear over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest for 10 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Spoon over the chimichurri.

recipes.title: Venezuelan Pabellon Criollo
steps: Simmer the steak in salted water for 1 hour until tender, then shred it.
Cook the onion, pepper and garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add the cumin, tomatoes and shredded beef with a little broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Warm the beans with a pinch of cumin, and fry the plantain slices in the rest of the oil.
Serve the beef with rice, beans and plantain.

recipes.title: Cuban Picadillo
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes, then the garlic.
Add the beef with the cumin and oregano and brown it.
Stir in the tomato sauce, olives, raisins and capers and simmer for 15 minutes.
Season and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Arroz con Gandules
steps: Fry the ham in the oil, then the sofrito for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, sazon and olives, then the rice and stir to coat.
Add the pigeon peas, water and salt, bring to a boil and cook uncovered until the water drops to the level of the rice.
Cover and cook on low for 20 minutes without lifting the lid.

recipes.title: Jamaican Rice and Peas
steps: Bring the beans and liquid, coconut milk and 250 ml water to a simmer with the green onions, thyme, whole pepper, allspice, garlic and salt.
Stir in the rice, return to a simmer, cover tightly and cook on low for 25 minutes.
Remove the aromatics (keep the pepper whole so it doesn't burst) and fluff.

recipes.title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
steps: Blend everything except the chicken into a paste (wear gloves for the peppers).
Rub over the chicken and marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Grill over medium heat or roast at 200 °C for 35 to 40 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through to 74 °C.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken Mole (Quick)
steps: Toast the chilies briefly, seed them and soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil, then blend with the chilies, tomatoes, almonds, half the sesame, raisins, spices and stock until very smooth.
Simmer the sauce for 15 minutes, stir in the chocolate and season.
Add the chicken and simmer covered for 25 minutes; top with the remaining sesame.

recipes.title: Mexican Chiles Rellenos (Baked)
steps: Char the poblanos under the grill until blistered, steam in a covered bowl for 10 minutes, peel and make a slit to remove the seeds.
Fill with cheese.
Simmer the tomato sauce with the onion, garlic and oregano for 10 minutes and pour into a baking dish.
Beat the whites stiff, fold in the yolks and flour, dip each pepper and set on the sauce.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C).
Brown the beef and onion in the oil, add the spices, beans, tomatoes and corn and simmer for 10 minutes; pour into a baking dish.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, egg, milk and half the cheese and spread over the filling.
Scatter with the remaining cheese and bake for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas Verdes
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the salsa with the sour cream.
Mix the chicken with the onion, a third of the sauce and half the cheese.
Warm the tortillas, fill and roll them, and lay seam-side down in a dish.
Pour over the rest of the sauce and cheese and bake for 20 minutes; scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Cochinita Pibil
steps: Blend the achiote, orange and lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano and salt and marinate the pork overnight.
Wrap tightly in banana leaves or foil in a roasting dish and bake at 160 °C for 3 hours until it falls apart.
Meanwhile pickle the onion in the vinegar with a pinch of salt.
Shred the pork in its juices and serve in tortillas with the pickled onion.

recipes.title: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Paella
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo in the oil in a paella pan or wide frying pan.
Add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the garlic, paprika and saffron.
Stir in the tomatoes for 3 minutes, then scatter in the rice evenly and pour over the hot stock; season.
Simmer without stirring for 18 to 20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 5; turn the heat up for the last minute to form the socarrat.
Rest 5 minutes under a cloth and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Shrimp (Gambas al Ajillo)
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic and chili in a small frying pan over medium-low heat until the garlic is pale gold.
Turn up the heat, add the shrimp and paprika and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once.
Add the sherry and parsley and season.
Serve sizzling with bread.

recipes.title: Portuguese Caldo Verde
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in half the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, water and salt and simmer for 20 minutes until soft, then mash or blend.
Brown the chorizo separately.
Add the kale to the soup and simmer for 4 minutes, then top with the chorizo and the remaining oil.

recipes.title: Greek Pastitsio
steps: Cook the pasta until just underdone and drain.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in the oil, add the cinnamon and tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick; off the heat whisk in the eggs, nutmeg and half the cheese.
Layer half the pasta, the meat, the rest of the pasta and the sauce in a dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 to 45 minutes and rest 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Greek Gigantes Plaki
steps: Simmer the soaked beans for 45 minutes to 1 hour until just tender and drain.
Cook the onion and carrots in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes, paste and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix with the beans and dill in a baking dish, add a splash of water, and bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes until thick.
Serve warm or at room temperature with feta.

recipes.title: Greek Spanakorizo
steps: Cook the onion and green onions in the oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and tomato paste, then add the spinach in handfuls until wilted.
Pour in the stock, season, cover and simmer for 18 to 20 minutes.
Stir in the dill and lemon juice and serve with feta.

recipes.title: French Ratatouille Tian
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C.
Cook the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil, stir into the passata and spread in a baking dish.
Arrange the vegetable slices upright in alternating rows over the sauce.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil, scatter with herbs, salt and pepper, cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes, then uncover for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: French Lentils with Sausage
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, bay leaf and stock and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile fry the sausages for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the mustard and vinegar into the lentils, season and serve with the sausages.

recipes.title: German Kasespatzle
steps: Beat the flour, eggs, milk, nutmeg and 1 tsp salt to a thick, sticky batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Fry the onions in 2 tbsp butter until deep golden, about 15 minutes.
Press the batter through a spaetzle maker or colander into simmering salted water; lift out when they float.
Layer the spaetzle with cheese in a buttered dish, keep warm until melted and top with the onions and chives.

recipes.title: German Sauerbraten-Style Pot Roast
steps: Bring the vinegar, wine, 250 ml water, vegetables and spices to the boil, cool, and marinate the beef in it in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, turning daily.
Dry the beef, brown it in the oil in a heavy pot, add the strained marinade, cover and simmer gently for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Lift out the beef, stir the crushed gingersnaps and raisins into the liquid and simmer until thick.
Slice the beef and serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Polish Pierogi with Potato and Cheese
steps: Mix the flour, egg, water, oil and 1 tsp salt to a soft dough, knead 5 minutes and rest covered for 30 minutes.
Fry the onions in the butter until golden; mix half into the potato and cheese and season well.
Roll the dough thin, cut 7 cm rounds, fill with a spoonful, fold and pinch firmly closed.
Boil in batches until they float plus 2 minutes, then toss with the rest of the onions and butter and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onions for 8 minutes, then take the pan off the heat and stir in the paprika so it doesn't burn.
Add the pepper, tomato, stock and chicken, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Whisk the flour into the sour cream, stir it in and simmer 3 minutes; season and serve with noodles.

recipes.title: Georgian Lobio (Kidney Bean Stew)
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then the garlic.
Add the beans with their liquid and simmer for 10 minutes, mashing about half.
Stir in the walnuts, spices and vinegar and simmer 5 minutes.
Season and fold in plenty of cilantro.

recipes.title: Swedish Pytt i Panna
steps: Fry the potatoes in 2 tbsp butter over medium-high heat until golden and crisp, about 12 minutes.
Add the onion and meat and fry 8 minutes more; season.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the butter.
Serve the hash topped with an egg, with pickled beets and parsley.

recipes.title: British Cottage Pie
steps: Brown the beef with the vegetables in the oil, stir in the paste and flour, then the stock and worcestershire, and simmer for 25 minutes.
Boil the potatoes until soft and mash with the butter and milk.
Spoon the filling into a dish, top with the mash and cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 to 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Irish Colcannon
steps: Boil the potatoes until soft.
Meanwhile cook the cabbage in 1 tbsp butter with a splash of water until tender, about 6 minutes.
Warm the milk with the green onions.
Mash the potatoes with the milk and the rest of the butter, fold in the cabbage and season.

recipes.title: Scottish Cullen Skink
steps: Poach the haddock in the milk and water for 5 minutes, lift out and flake it, keeping the liquid.
Cook the onion and leek in the butter for 8 minutes.
Add the potatoes and poaching liquid and simmer for 15 minutes until soft; mash a few potatoes.
Add the fish, heat through, season with pepper and add chives.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken Piccata
steps: Season and flour the chicken.
Fry in the oil and 1 tbsp butter for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Add the garlic, wine, stock, lemon juice and capers and simmer for 3 minutes.
Swirl in the rest of the butter, return the chicken and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca
steps: Lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each escalope and secure with a toothpick.
Dust the underside with flour.
Fry prosciutto-side down in the oil and butter for 2 minutes, then turn for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the wine, let it bubble for a minute and spoon the sauce over.

recipes.title: Risi e Bisi
steps: Cook the onion and pancetta in 2 tbsp butter for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the stock a ladle at a time with the peas, stirring, for 18 minutes; it should stay soupy.
Stir in the rest of the butter, parmesan and parsley, and season.

recipes.title: Persian Herb Stew (Ghormeh Sabzi)
steps: Brown the onion and lamb with the turmeric in 1 tbsp oil, add the water and simmer for 1 hour.
Fry the herbs in the remaining oil for 15 minutes until dark and fragrant, then add the fenugreek.
Add the herbs, dried limes and salt to the lamb and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the beans for the last 15 minutes and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Persian Jeweled Rice
steps: Soak the rice for 30 minutes, then boil in salted water for 6 minutes and drain.
Blanch the orange zest twice, then warm it with the dried fruit, sugar and 1 tbsp butter for 3 minutes.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in the pot, layer the rice with the fruit and cardamom, make a few holes with a spoon handle and drizzle with the saffron steeped in 3 tbsp hot water and the last butter.
Cover with a cloth-wrapped lid and steam on low for 35 minutes; top with the nuts.

recipes.title: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma Wraps
steps: Marinate the chicken with the spices, garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt for at least 1 hour.
Roast at 220 °C for 20 to 25 minutes or grill until charred.
Rest and slice thinly.
Wrap in flatbreads with the garlic sauce, tomato and pickles.

recipes.title: Turkish Imam Bayildi
steps: Peel the eggplants in stripes, slit each lengthways without cutting through, salt them for 20 minutes and pat dry.
Fry them in half the oil until browned all over.
Cook the onions slowly in the rest of the oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes, sugar, salt and parsley.
Stuff the eggplants, set in a dish with 120 ml water and lemon juice and bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes; serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Turkish Menemen
steps: Cook the peppers in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and chili flakes and simmer for 6 minutes until thick.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just softly set.
Season and scatter with parsley; serve with bread.

recipes.title: Israeli Sabich Sandwich
steps: Salt the eggplant slices and fry in the oil until golden on both sides; drain.
Mix the tomato, cucumber and parsley as a salad.
Spread the pitas with hummus and fill with eggplant, sliced egg, salad, tahini sauce and amba.

recipes.title: Indian Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead the flour, water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest 20 minutes.
Mix the potato with the chili, spices, cilantro and salt.
Roll a ball of dough to a small circle, put a ball of filling in the centre, gather the edges, seal and roll gently to 18 cm.
Cook on a hot griddle, brushing with ghee, for 2 minutes per side until spotted golden.
Serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Indian Rajma Masala
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in the oil, then the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the beans and water and simmer for 20 minutes, mashing a few beans.
Season and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Indian Baingan Bharta
steps: Char the eggplants over a gas flame or under the grill, turning, until collapsed and smoky, about 15 minutes; peel and mash.
Fry the cumin seeds in the oil, then the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and chili.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, then the eggplant and garam masala for 5 minutes more.
Season and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Pakistani Chicken Karahi
steps: Fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the ginger and garlic for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, chilies, spices and salt.
Cook uncovered, stirring, for 15 minutes until the tomatoes break down and the oil separates.
Stir in the yogurt and garam masala for 3 minutes and finish with cilantro and julienned ginger.

recipes.title: Nepali Chicken Momos
steps: Knead the flour and water to a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, cilantro, cumin, soy and salt.
Roll small thin rounds, fill and pleat closed.
Steam on oiled parchment for 12 minutes.
Blend the roasted tomatoes and chili with salt for the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Korean Bibimbap
steps: Cook the beef with the soy sauce and half the sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts and season each with sesame oil and salt; quickly saute the carrot, zucchini and mushrooms separately.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Divide the rice into bowls, arrange the vegetables and beef on top, add an egg and serve with gochujang and sesame; mix everything before eating.

recipes.title: Korean Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Fry the pork in the oil until it renders, then add the kimchi and fry for 4 minutes.
Stir in the gochugaru and gochujang, add the water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Slide in the tofu and simmer 5 minutes.
Add green onions and sesame oil and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Oyakodon
steps: Simmer the dashi, soy, mirin and sugar in a small frying pan, add the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer for 6 minutes until cooked.
Pour over the eggs in a circle, cover and cook for 1 minute until just set.
Slide over bowls of rice and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, then add the onion, potatoes and carrots and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the dashi, soy, mirin and sugar, bring to a simmer and skim.
Cover with a smaller lid resting on the food and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the green beans for the last 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bun Cha
steps: Mix the pork with half the fish sauce, the sugar, shallots and garlic and shape into small patties; rest 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry for 3 to 4 minutes per side until charred.
Warm the nuoc cham with a splash of water and the carrot.
Serve the patties in bowls of the sauce with noodles, lettuce and herbs alongside for dipping.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork
steps: Melt the sugar in a heavy pot until deep amber, then carefully add the pork and stir to coat.
Add the fish sauce, shallots, garlic and coconut water, bring to a simmer and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until the sauce is sticky.
Season with pepper and scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Gai
steps: Cook the chicken in a dry pan with 3 tbsp water, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until just cooked.
Off the heat, stir in the fish sauce, lime juice and chili.
Add the rice powder, shallots and herbs and toss.
Serve warm or at room temperature with lettuce cups.

recipes.title: Indonesian Nasi Goreng
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic, chili and shrimp paste in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the rice, kecap manis and soy and stir-fry over high heat for 4 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil and serve on top with cucumber and fried shallots.

recipes.title: Filipino Chicken Tinola
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and fish sauce and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the water and simmer for 20 minutes, skimming.
Add the papaya and simmer 8 minutes until tender, then the spinach for 1 minute; season with pepper.

recipes.title: Filipino Pancit Bihon
steps: Soak the noodles in warm water for 10 minutes and drain.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil, then the chicken for 4 minutes.
Add the carrot, cabbage and snow peas for 2 minutes, then the soy and stock and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and toss until they absorb the liquid; serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Poke Bowls
steps: Toss the tuna with the soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, green onions and sesame seeds; chill for 15 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with the tuna, avocado, cucumber and nori. Use only fish sold for eating raw.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo Tofu
steps: Fry the pork in the oil until crisp, then the bean paste, black beans, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the stock and slide in the tofu; simmer for 5 minutes without stirring too much.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water.
Sprinkle with the ground peppercorns and green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble softly in 1 tbsp hot oil; tip out while still wet.
Add the rest of the oil and the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until juicy, with the sugar, ketchup and salt.
Return the eggs and fold through.
Scatter with green onions and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Black Bean Bowl
steps: Cook the grain in salted water according to the packet and drain or fluff.

Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Toss the vegetables that need cooking with the oil, any spice and salt and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once (keep cucumber, cabbage, leaves and fresh tomatoes raw).
Cook or warm the protein: pan-fry tofu, tempeh, chicken or shrimp until golden and cooked through; just rinse and drain canned beans.
Whisk the dressing ingredients with a splash of water and salt to taste.
Build the bowls: grain first, then the vegetables and protein, a spoonful of dressing and the toppings.

Toss the protein with the rest of the oil and the seasoning, add it to the pan and roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through (chicken to 74 °C / 165 °F).

ingredients.name: Corn on the cob, in thirds

steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the vegetables with half the oil, salt and pepper and spread them out in one layer; roast for 15 minutes first if they are potatoes or root vegetables.
Toss the protein with the rest of the oil and the seasoning, add it to the pan and roast for about 20 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through (chicken to 74 °C / 165 °F).
Finish with any lemon, sauce, cheese or herbs from the list and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Eggs with Peppers and Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the vegetables with half the oil, salt and pepper and spread them out in one layer; roast for 15 minutes first if they are potatoes or root vegetables.
Make 6 wells in the vegetables, crack in the eggs and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the whites are set.
Finish with any lemon, sauce, cheese or herbs from the list and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia and maple syrup together in two jars.
Mix in the apple, cinnamon and walnuts, keeping a little fruit for the top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Stir, loosen with a splash of milk and eat cold or warmed.

recipes.title: Matcha Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia and maple syrup together in two jars.
Mix in the matcha (whisked into the milk) and kiwi, keeping a little fruit for the top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Stir, loosen with a splash of milk and eat cold or warmed.

recipes.title: Green Spinach Banana Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness or thickness with more liquid, and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness or thickness with more liquid, and serve straight away.

steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness or thickness with more liquid, and serve straight away.

steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness or thickness with more liquid, and serve straight away.

steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness or thickness with more liquid, and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Peach Ginger Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness or thickness with more liquid, and serve straight away.
